description_expanded: Arrabella - Pet-Friendly Vacation Rental on 30A with Community Pool Favorite Features: - Pet-Friendly Property - Just Steps to Community Pool Access - Outdoor Dining Area with Grill - Walking Distance to Local Restaurants & Beach Access - Gulf Views from Upper Floors More About Arrabella: Welcome to Arrabella, a coastal getaway that blends beachside beauty with all the comforts of home. Located along scenic 30A, this bright and inviting retreat is just a 5-minute walk from the beach and within easy walking distance to local restaurants and cafés. Perfect for families and small groups, Arrabella offers the ideal mix of relaxation and convenience. Inside, the home features three spacious levels filled with natural light and coastal-inspired décor. The open-concept living area includes a comfortable lounge, a modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances, and a large dining table perfect for family meals. Upstairs, guests can enjoy Gulf views from the upper balcony—an ideal spot for morning coffee or sunset unwinding. Just steps from the front door, the community pool provides a refreshing escape after a day at the beach. Lounge in the sun, take a cool dip, or enjoy a relaxed afternoon surrounded by palm trees and coastal breezes. Evenings are best spent grilling outdoors and dining al fresco on the private patio. Whether you're here to explore 30A’s charming beach towns, unwind by the water, or simply relax in a serene setting, Arrabella is your perfect home base for an unforgettable Emerald Coast getaway. Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: Queen Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 2: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 3: Twin over Full Bunk with Twin Trundle & Shared Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 4: Twin over Full Bunk with Twin Trundle & Shared Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. THIRD FLOOR Bedroom 5: Queen Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower.
